**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause is `dep-4471`, a gateway config change by `a.novak`. It shipped connection-per-request. First 503 landed 19 seconds after the deploy finished.

Impact window is 02:14:18Z to at least 03:59:27Z. That is 1h 45m, still failing at log cutoff. 530 of 636 requests failed on this node.

The doc also flags two things not to chase. Workers are clean. Their separate slowdown predates the deploy.

Next: roll back `dep-4471`.
